watch.summary: The creator tries to hide inside a wall cutout during a party game, but bursts into wheezing laughter when he realizes his character's limbs and body stick out completely.

beats.what: The creator checks the countdown timer and attempts to fit into the wall hole.
He turns the camera and spots his character's head awkwardly protruding through the wall.
He explodes into wheezing laughter at how bad the fit is.
He inspects the other side and sees his arm sticking out just as badly.
He looks behind and notices his butt sticking entirely out of the wall.
He accepts defeat and accepts that he is cooked.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The comedy stems from the visual absurdity of his character failing to hide, paired with the creator's extremely contagious wheezing laugh.
